motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: Measured height tween for pointer toggles.

motion.name: magnetic-spring
motion.value: stiffness 180; damping 18; x factor 0.075; y factor 0.12

components.name: Primary contact
components.description: Direct contact action; magnetic motion is implemented by React on the live page.

components.name: Section navigation
components.description: Compact floating reading navigator; live selection follows scrolling.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;padding:6px;border:1px solid #ffffffd9;border-radius:18px;background:#fdfefbe8;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);box-shadow:0 8px 28px -16px #264d3840,inset 0 1px 0 white}.ds-nav a{padding:10px 22px;border-radius:12px;color:var(--muted,#5c6c63);font:600 12px/1.7 Manrope,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:color 180ms ease}.ds-nav a[aria-current],.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--ink,#192a24)}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{background:#e7f0e8}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green,#276647);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Experience disclosure
components.description: Native career disclosure; live pointer expansion is animated.
components.css: .ds-experience{background:var(--surface,#fff);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;transition:box-shadow 200ms ease}.ds-experience[open]{box-shadow:0 8px 20px -17px #294f3744}.ds-experience:hover{box-shadow:0 10px 24px -18px #173e3250}.ds-experience summary{padding:25px 28px;cursor:pointer;font-size:20px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink,#192a24)}.ds-experience p{padding:0 28px 27px;margin:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--muted,#5c6c63)}.ds-experience summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green,#276647);outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview: White résumé panels sit on a light green field. A real portrait, readable career history and direct contact actions carry the identity; depth and motion support that hierarchy. This documents the implemented direction, not a claim of user approval.
keyCharacteristics: Clear role typography and compact profile composition.
Soft green surfaces, rounded panels and restrained shadows.
Optional motion with readable content before JavaScript.
dos: Do retain the real portrait, localized specialization and immediate contact/PDF links.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, native disclosures and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep supporting motion subordinate to readable résumé content.
donts: Don't reintroduce the rejected large 3D hero sculpture.
Don't treat decorative gradients or one-off colors as new semantic roles.
